title: cert.rs: Vec<&&Certificate> from .iter() on Vec<&Certificate> — use .copied()
description: cert.rs:86 collects Vec<&&Certificate> by calling .iter() on candidates: Vec<&Certificate>. The subsequent for loop gets anchor: &&&Certificate which relies on auto-deref to satisfy verify_signature(&Certificate, &Certificate). A contributor reading the code must mentally track three levels of indirection. Idiomatic fix: use .iter().copied() to convert &&Certificate → &Certificate, producing Vec<&Certificate> and anchor: &Certificate in the loop. The code behavior is identical; the types become self-evident.
